cases.name: Taylor Gennalee Maraj
cases.caseStatus: PRISON PAROLEE / ON PROBATION; SUSPECT DECEASED
cases.narrative: On 5/24/2025, Maraj drove to the gas station with Cureton and went inside. She asked multiple people for help, but then Cureton came inside and said it was time to go. Maraj told him no. That’s when Cureton pulled out a gun. Cureton then forced Maraj back into the car through the driver’s side. Maraj tried to get out on the other side, but was not able. He shot and killed her along Interstate 85 northbound near River Road and the Piedmont exit.
